notes: All domains have skill, primary official source lead, clear observable acceptance and blocker. Metadata alone does not certify an execution, current provider policy or production search outcome.

domains.acceptance_evidence: Original reported human job plus independently tested substitute
domains.critical_failure: User need based only on an LLM assumption

domains.acceptance_evidence: Geo/device/date/unit and actual permitted export or honest hypothesis
domains.critical_failure: Invented Google volume or CPC-to-RPM conversion

domains.acceptance_evidence: Actual locale/device organic competitor and direct task outputs
domains.critical_failure: Only modeled rankings or generic SERP screenshot

domains.acceptance_evidence: Current original spam policy and negative doorway/fake-tool test
domains.critical_failure: Scaled low-value synonym/city page or fake functionality

domains.acceptance_evidence: Original examples/method and real useful page copy
domains.critical_failure: Reworded competitor copy or invented ratings

domains.acceptance_evidence: Crawlable native links and orphan/duplicate graph report
domains.critical_failure: Orphans/doorways or JS-only primary navigation

domains.acceptance_evidence: Actual deployed DNS/TLS, 200/301/404 and cache/headers

domains.acceptance_evidence: Per-bot route evaluation and actual WAF verification
domains.critical_failure: Googlebot blocked on indexable page

domains.acceptance_evidence: Raw+rendered noindex and X-Robots-Tag consistency

domains.acceptance_evidence: Chosen page family, links/redirect/sitemap and GSC selected canonical

domains.acceptance_evidence: Canonical indexable URL set, correct XML, real lastmod

domains.acceptance_evidence: Initial HTML plus actual browser DOM/missing JS mutant

domains.acceptance_evidence: Visible true structured data and current eligible type

domains.acceptance_evidence: Rights, real image/video URLs, alt, original context

domains.acceptance_evidence: Real translated human-tested content, hreflang relationship

domains.acceptance_evidence: Field p75 vs lab instrumentation, long task/CLS diagnostics

domains.acceptance_evidence: Actual keyboard, screen reader/mobile controls and states

domains.acceptance_evidence: Minimal workload placement with measured CPU/egress/memory budget

domains.acceptance_evidence: Server/API/DB contracts, auth and validated failure cases

domains.acceptance_evidence: Shipped core output independent byte oracle and cross-engine E2E

domains.acceptance_evidence: Real dataflow, consent and retention requirements checked

domains.acceptance_evidence: Current original content policy, each page ad suitability
domains.critical_failure: Ads on non-content screens or misleading download

domains.acceptance_evidence: Real owner account site approval and precise policy status

domains.acceptance_evidence: Provider-specific crawlers, citations, genuine referral/intent trial

domains.acceptance_evidence: Authorized owner URL indexing and GSC query/page/date measures

domains.acceptance_evidence: Measured query click and task funnel with confounders

domains.acceptance_evidence: Staging rollback, monitoring, backup and security testing

domains.acceptance_evidence: Net cost per successful task, p95 CPU/egress and abuse bounds
